description: Lists the 28 sources the statistics page cites (out of the 93 references the site holds): peer-reviewed studies with DOI or PMID where the site prints one, plus official statistics and guidelines. Each row has the key, citation, identifiers, link, kind (article or web), the topics it supports and, for population studies, the get_prevalence entry ids built from it; rows keep the site's reference-list order. Use this to find which sources back a topic or to discover reference keys; use get_reference instead for one key's full record (it also covers references the statistics page does not cite), and get_citation to cite the dyscalculia.io compilation as a whole. With no topic it returns all 28 sources; an unknown topic returns an error listing the valid topics.

topic.description: Keep only sources cited for this section of the statistics page (exact, lowercase; 2 to 8 sources each). Valid: prevalence, persistence, math-anxiety, interventions, by-country, sex-ratio, comorbidity, key-figures, family, official-counts, method. Omit for every cited source.
